svg.text: Camera slider — ORIGINAL PROTOTYPE, full point-to-point wiring
ESP32-S3 N16R8 · 3x TMC2209 breakout boards, UART mode · TCA9548A mux for pan/tilt AS5600 · one dedicated encoder per axis · slide-only limit switches · OLED optional
GPIO41 → UART RX ← drivers' TX net
GPIO47 → UART TX → drivers' RX net
resistor is on each breakout, not a discrete part here
optional · I2C bus B, own bus
